strategy.title: No executable plan yet: ballast-water record packs have no established way to reach the buyers
strategy.why: Price ($2,500), demand, volume (90 operators registered with the port authority, one pack per vessel per year), Brain fulfilment, $50 cost and 14-day settlement are evidenced, and two sales would carry the $5,000. But no published, permitted channel to contact these operators is recorded - the register is a count, not a contact route - and the 9-of-120 pre-order figure does not say where or on whom it was measured, so no close rate is established for any channel Brain could use.

alternatives.title: Conditional outreach test
alternatives.why: Not startable: a live test needs a channel to send through, and none is established.

steps.label: Establish a published channel to the 90 registered coastal operators (the port-authority register's published contacts or the operators' own contact pages) and how many it reaches

noPlan.decisiveGap: No published, permitted channel to reach coastal ship operators is established; without one no offer can be sent and no close rate measured.
noPlan.resolution: Answer research need cnd_ab3633f52d704f998d5b: record the port authority register's published contact route (or the operators' own published contact pages) with its source and how many of the 90 it reaches; then send the $2,500 offer to measure the close rate - two sales settle the target within 30 days.

review.reasons: NO_PLAN with REACHABLE_BUYER as the decisive gap matches the evidence and Brain's own judgement. The port-authority register gives a count of 90 operators but no published, permitted contact route. The 9/120 pre-order figure does not state its page or population, so no close rate exists for any usable channel. Without a channel a live test cannot start, so CONDITIONAL is correctly rejected. The resolution is concrete: answer access need cnd_ab3633f52d704f998d5b, then send the $2,500 offer, where two sales ($5,000, 14-day settlement, $50 cost each) would fit the 30-day window. No constraint is misattributed, and nothing unknown is treated as known.
